messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
Our orders of part:360020 were placed at 4.29 (po:4500011528-10, 2024-10) and 4.39 EUR (po:4500014467-10, 2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your response and the proposed volume commitment. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately.

We are very happy to present our offer of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can agree to the 14-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, for which we can offer a revised price of €4.87 per unit with a price of €4.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued interest and the volume commitment. We always appreciate working with you and value our strong relationship. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

As an alternative, for the 14-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can make a slight adjustment to €4.86 per unit. So we can offer a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This represents the absolute limit of what we can offer under the current circumstances. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued interest and the proposed volume commitment. As your trusted distributor, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive range and high service standards. 

We have reviewed your latest request, but we cannot accommodate any further price reductions for the 14-day payment terms and 24-month contract. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This is our final offer at €4.86 per unit, as we are unable to make any further concessions.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. We hope to continue our successful partnership!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
